title: Assumption Ledger Sorter
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Entrepreneurship
description: A six-card sorting quiz in which learners classify statements from a mobile dog-grooming idea as untested assumptions or validated learning, with immediate green or amber feedback and a one-sentence explanation for each card.

prerequisites: Chapter 1: Entrepreneurship, Lean Thinking & the Idea Trap
learningObjectives: Classify statements as Assumption (untested) or Validated Learning (tested) by applying the chapter's definitions

controls.label: Assumption
controls.purpose: Classify the current card as an untested assumption

controls.label: Validated Learning
controls.purpose: Classify the current card as tested evidence

controls.label: Try Again
controls.purpose: Reshuffle the cards and start over

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Classification quiz with immediate corrective feedback
keyQuestions: Did a real customer actually say or do this, or does it only sound true?
Why is a customer's 'no' still validated learning?
commonMisconceptions: Only positive results count as validated learning
A statement that sounds obviously true has been validated
assessmentOpportunities: Score at least 5 of 6 on a second, shuffled attempt
Label three statements about your own idea
